package postgres

import (
	"context"

	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain/repository"
	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5/pgxpool"
)

// LessonI18nRepoPG implements LessonI18nRepository.
type LessonI18nRepoPG struct {
	Pool *pgxpool.Pool
}

// Upsert inserts or updates lesson localization.
func (r LessonI18nRepoPG) Upsert(ctx context.Context, entry domain.LessonI18n) error {
	runner := getRunner(ctx, r.Pool)
	_, err := runner.Exec(ctx, `
INSERT INTO lesson_i18n (lesson_id, i18n_id, title, excerpt, description)
VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5)
ON CONFLICT (lesson_id, i18n_id)
DO UPDATE SET title = EXCLUDED.title, excerpt = EXCLUDED.excerpt, description = EXCLUDED.description
`, entry.LessonID, entry.I18nID, entry.Title, entry.Excerpt, entry.Description)
	return err
}

// ListByLesson lists all localizations for lesson.
func (r LessonI18nRepoPG) ListByLesson(ctx context.Context, lessonID string) ([]domain.LessonI18n, error) {
	runner := getRunner(ctx, r.Pool)
	rows, err := runner.Query(ctx, `
SELECT li.lesson_id, li.i18n_id, i.language, li.title, li.excerpt, li.description
FROM lesson_i18n li
JOIN i18n i ON i.id = li.i18n_id
WHERE li.lesson_id = $1
ORDER BY i.language
`, lessonID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	defer rows.Close()

	result := make([]domain.LessonI18n, 0)
	for rows.Next() {
		var entry domain.LessonI18n
		if err := rows.Scan(
			&entry.LessonID,
			&entry.I18nID,
			&entry.Language,
			&entry.Title,
			&entry.Excerpt,
			&entry.Description,
		); err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		result = append(result, entry)
	}

	if rows.Err() != nil {
		return nil, rows.Err()
	}

	return result, nil
}

var _ repository.LessonI18nRepository = (*LessonI18nRepoPG)(nil)
